sections.label: Pallavi
sections.ta:
தண்மையின் தனித்தன்மை தணிகையுறை குமரனே
தண்மதியணி தயாபரன் தனயனே
sections.translit:
thaNmaiyin thanitthanmai thaNigaiyuRai kumaranE
thaNmadhiyaNi dhayAparan thanayanE
sections.en: The Lord who dwells in the Thanigai hills is the embodiment of coolness. He is the son of Lord Siva, the merciful one who wears the cool moon.

sections.label: Anupallavi
sections.ta:
தணலிடைப் பிறந்து தண்ணீரில் திளைத்து
தண்டமிழ்ப் ப
ா சுவைத்து தமியோர்க்கருளும்
sections.translit:
thaNalidaip piRandhu thaNNIril thiLaitthu
thaNdamizhp pA suvaitthu thamiyOrkkaruLum
sections.en: Lord Muruga was born from a flame and placed in the cool water of Saravana pond. He relishes every bit of sweet Tamil poetry. He showers blessings on the desolate masses.

sections.label: Charanam
sections.ta:
தன் நாவே புரளாது தவித்திட்ட தவபாலர்க்கும்
தன் மதியிழந்து தாரணியில் சீரிழந்து விதியென
தன்னுயிரை மாய்த்திடவே முயன்றதோர் அன்பர்க்கும்
தன்னேரிலா தலைவனாய் தருணத்தே வந்து காத்த
sections.translit:
than nAvE puraLAdhu thavitthitta thavabAlarkkum
than madhiyizhandhu dhAraniyil sIrizhandhu vidhiyena
thannuyirai mAytthidavE muyandRadhOr anbarkkum
thannErilA thalaivanAy tharuNatthE vandhu kAttha
sections.en: Lord Muruga came at the appropriate moment when a child lost motor function in his tongue and could not speak. The Lord helped another devotee who, after losing his reputation due to youthful bad acts, had decided to end his own life. Lord Muruga protected both of these devotees and uplifted them. He is an incomparable savior and protector.

notes: Lord Muruga rested in Thiruttani to calm himself after the killing of the demon Soorapadman. The Tamil word Thanigai implies cooling, which is why the shrine city is referred to as ThiruththaNigai. Any person coming to the shrine to see the Lord will get immense peace and joy. Rama, after killing Ravana, was advised by Siva to visit this shrine, which is how Rama obtained peace. The charanam in this song refers to the stories of two great saints. Line 1 Kumaraguruparar did not utter a word until age five. Later, he obtained the blessings of Lord Muruga in Tiruchendur, and spontaneously came up with the divine Saivite chant of Kandar Kali Venba. Kumaraguruparar Story Lines 2, 3 Arunagirinathar lost all his wealth and his reputation because of youthful bad acts. Lord Muruga of Thiruvannamalai saved him and blessed him to compose the Thiruppugazh. Saint Arunagirinathar’s Tiruppugazh is considered a medieval literary treasure. Even though the two incidents cited in the charanam may have been in different abodes, I have taken the liberty of highlighting the Lord residing in Thiruththanigai in both instances. The Lord is omniscient and the song reflects this theme. Arunagirinathar’s Life Thiruttani Temple and Legends
